lines.text: Many learners say: It is cold on the street.
Outside means not in a house.
Outside! It is hot outside today.

data.wrong: It is cold on the street.
data.why: Outside means not in a house.

native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “It is cold on the street”? 😅 Русское «на улице холодно» часто переводят дословно — “on the street”, но по-английски говорят “outside.” Правильно: “It is cold outside.” Послушай Карлоса и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “outside.” «На улице» — это outside. Скажи вслух: “It is cold outside.” Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.tip: Say “outside,” not “on the street”: “It is cold outside.”
en.caption: Do you also say “It is cold on the street”? 😅 People often translate the Russian phrase word for word as “on the street,” but English says “outside.” Correct: “It is cold outside.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
